headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a thrilling 4-3 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture, while Vladimir Guerrero Jr. is on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. Abner Uribe, Colt Emerson, Davis Martin, and Garrett Whitlock are also out with various injuries.

The Milwaukee Brewers bolstered their infield with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas in a trade with the Athletics for cash.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 4-3 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Joshua Báez leading the charge at the plate. Báez hit 3 home runs and drove in 5 runs, while Michael McGreevy pitched 6 strong innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Blue Jays 4-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees suffered a 4-1 loss to the Toronto Blue Jays in their latest matchup. Charles McAdoo led the Yankees' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Fall to Giants in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Colorado Rockies, winning 7-1 behind a strong performance from Logan Webb. Webb pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Rivero Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels catcher Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture. This move is effective immediately.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have added shortstop Jonathan Ornelas to their roster, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash.
